text.p: The Athens stock exchange resumed trade on Wednesday in thin trade. Business worth less than 14 million drachmas was conducted in early dealings, exchange sources said.
The general share index was down 0.22 percent at the opening at 918.74 points.

Ten securities firms had been admitted to the floor -- they were Alpha Brokerage, Egnatia Securities, Sigma Securities, Ionian Securities, Petropoulakis Brokerage, Hrysochoides brokerage and Macedonia-Thrace Securities, P and K Securities, National Securities and Telesis Securities, sources said.
More member brokers were being admitted gradually.

The crisis at the exchange was defused after the National Economy Ministry and the brokers association reached common ground late on Tuesday on ways to resolve the deadlock after the Delta Securities scandal.
Officials said on Tuesday the bourse would open late today but they expected it to be back to normal on Thursday.
